title: Understanding Verification Vulnerabilities in Cross-chain Bridges: An Empirical Study
title_zh: 理解跨链桥接中的验证漏洞：一项实证研究

paragraphs.en: With the rapid development of blockchain technology, numerous heterogeneous blockchains have emerged, each featuring distinct architectures, consensus mechanisms, and application ecosystems. Cross-chain bridges have consequently become a critical infrastructure component, typically relying on smart contracts to facilitate message passing and asset transfers across heterogeneous blockchains. Unlike single-chain contracts, bridge contracts introduce additional verification logic to validate external-chain data, such as state proofs, message sender identities, and signatures. However, correctly implementing such logic is challenging. We refer to vulnerabilities that violate the security guarantees of cross-chain verification as Cross-chain Verification Vulnerabilities (CVVs). To characterize CVVs, we conduct the first systematic empirical study of this vulnerability class. By analyzing 588 security audit reports from 36 real-world cross-chain bridge projects, we derive 11 CVV patterns and organize them into 5 high-level categories according to the affected verification properties. Following this taxonomy, we construct a CVV dataset containing 830 vulnerability instances across 786 contract files. The dataset establishes mappings among audit reports, audited source-code versions, affected source files, and CVV-pattern labels. We then assess existing detection approaches. Current tools provide limited documented coverage of CVV patterns, while only two of four evaluated LLMs outperform an all-pattern constant baseline of 29.3% Macro-F1; the best reaches 51.2%. Together, the limited tool coverage and inconsistent LLM gains motivate detection methods tailored to cross-chain verification semantics.
paragraphs.zh: 随着区块链技术的高速发展，大量异构区块链应运而生，每种区块链都具有独特的架构、共识机制和应用生态系统。 因此，跨链桥已成为关键的基础设施组件，通常依赖智能合约在异构区块链之间实现消息传递和资产转移。 与单链合约不同，桥接合约需要引入额外的验证逻辑，以验证来自外部链的数据，例如状态证明、消息发送者身份和签名。 然而，正确实现此类逻辑极具挑战性。 我们将那些违反跨链验证安全保证的安全漏洞称为“跨链验证漏洞”（CVVs）。 为了描述 CVVs 的特征，我们开展了针对这一类漏洞的首次系统性实证研究。 通过分析 36 个真实世界跨链桥项目的 588 份安全审计报告，我们提炼出 11 种 CVV 模式，并根据受影响的验证属性将其归入 5 个高级类别。 基于这一分类体系，我们构建了一个 CVV 数据集，其中包含来自 786 份合约文件的 830 个漏洞实例。 该数据集建立了审计报告、经审计的源代码版本、受影响的源文件以及 CVV 模式标签之间的映射关系。 随后，我们对现有的检测方法进行了评估。 当前工具对 CVV 模式的文档覆盖范围有限，而在四款评估的 LLM 中，仅有两款的表现优于 29.3% Macro-F1 的全模式恒定基线；表现最佳的一款达到了 51.2%。 工具覆盖范围的局限性和 LLM 性能提升的不一致性共同表明，有必要开发专门针对跨链验证语义的检测方法。

paragraphs.en: Smart contracts have become critical software components for managing digital assets and enforcing application logic on blockchains ( Ivanov et al., 2023 ) . As multi-chain ecosystems expand, smart contracts increasingly coordinate cross-chain operations in bridge protocols ( Lee et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . Unlike single-chain contracts, bridge contracts must verify the validity and trustworthiness of cross-chain messages, state proofs, signatures, and other data from external chains ( Chen, 2025 ) . Cross-chain verification is implemented via diverse mechanisms ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , such as multisignature schemes ( LayerZero Labs, 2026a ; Wormhole Foundation, 2026b ; Chainlink Labs, 2026 ) , light clients ( Cosmos, 2026 ; Aurora Labs, 2026 ; Frauenthaler et al., 2020 ) , and zero-knowledge proofs ( Xie et al., 2022 ; Westerkamp and Eberhardt, 2020 ) . Their distinct trust assumptions and security boundaries make cross-chain verification logic complex and prone to implementation vulnerabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 智能合约已成为管理数字资产并在区块链上执行应用逻辑的关键软件组件（Ivanov 等，2023）。 随着多链生态系统的扩展，智能合约在跨链桥接协议中越来越多地协调跨链操作（Lee 等，2023；Li 等，2025）。 与单链合约不同，桥接合约必须验证来自外部链的跨链消息、状态证明、签名和其他数据的合法性与可信性（Chen，2025）。 跨链验证通过多种机制实现（Zhang 等，2024），例如多重签名方案（LayerZero Labs，2026a；Wormhole Foundation，2026b；Chainlink Labs，2026）、轻客户端（Cosmos，2026；Aurora Labs，2026；Frauenthaler 等，2020）以及零知识证明（Xie 等，2022；Westerkamp 和 Eberhardt，2020）。 它们不同的信任假设和安全边界使得跨链验证逻辑变得复杂，且容易引入实现漏洞。

paragraphs.en: Recent cross-chain bridge incidents further demonstrate the severity of cross-chain verification vulnerabilities. As of June 2026, we identified at least 11 bridge attacks involving such vulnerabilities, resulting in about $330 million in asset losses ( SlowMist Security Team, 2026 ) . For example, the Kelp DAO rsETH bridge attack caused an estimated $292 million loss through forged LayerZero cross-chain messages ( LayerZero Labs, 2026c ) , while the Hyperbridge attack used forged state proofs to gain unauthorized privileges and mint one billion wDOT ( CertiK Security, 2026 ) . Although these incidents targeted different bridge designs, they share a common failure mode: invalid external-chain data was trusted and used to authorize cross-chain operations.
paragraphs.zh: 近期发生的跨链桥事件进一步揭示了跨链验证漏洞的严重性。 截至 2026 年 6 月，我们已发现至少 11 起涉及此类漏洞的跨链桥攻击，导致约 3.3 亿美元的资产损失（SlowMist Security Team, 2026）。 例如，Kelp DAO rsETH 跨链桥攻击通过伪造 LayerZero 跨链消息造成了约 2.92 亿美元的损失（LayerZero Labs, 2026c），而 Hyperbridge 攻击则利用伪造的状态证明获得了未经授权的权限，并铸造了十亿枚 wDOT（CertiK Security, 2026）。 尽管这些事件针对的是不同的跨链桥设计，但它们存在一个共同的故障模式：无效的外部链数据被信任并被用于授权跨链操作。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we define Cross-chain Verification Vulnerabilities (CVVs) as vulnerabilities that undermine the security guarantees of cross-chain verification. CVVs arise when bridge contracts incorrectly authenticate, interpret, or process external-chain data, such as messages, proofs, or signatures. For example, an access-control flaw is a CVV only if it causes data from an unauthorized cross-chain sender to be accepted.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们将跨链验证漏洞（CVVs）定义为破坏跨链验证安全保证的漏洞。 当桥接合约错误地验证、解释或处理来自外部链的数据（例如消息、证明或签名）时，就会出现 CVVs。 例如，只有当访问控制缺陷导致来自未经授权跨链发送方的数据被接受时，它才构成 CVV。

paragraphs.en: Existing smart contract security research has largely focused on single-chain vulnerabilities ( Chu et al., 2023 ; Zhu et al., 2024 ) , typically classifying them by implementation-level defects, such as access-control errors ( Ghaleb et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) and integer overflows ( Li et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2024 ) . While useful for describing how an implementation fails, such classifications do not capture which cross-chain verification guarantee is violated in verification-critical contexts. Recent studies on cross-chain bridge security ( Liao et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2022 ) mainly target specific scenarios, vulnerability patterns, or detection rules, leaving cross-chain verification vulnerabilities without a systematic semantic characterization. Meanwhile, although LLMs have shown promise in smart contract vulnerability detection ( Wei et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) , their ability to reason about these verification-semantic vulnerabilities remains unclear.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的智能合约安全研究主要关注单链漏洞（Chu 等人，2023；Zhu 等人，2024），通常根据实现层面的缺陷对其进行分类，例如访问控制错误（Ghaleb 等人，2023；Zhang 等人，2025b）和整数溢出（Li 等人，2023；Huang 等人，2024）。 尽管这类分类有助于描述实现失败的方式，但它们并未揭示在验证关键场景下究竟违反了哪项跨链验证保证。 近期关于跨链桥安全的研究（Liao 等人，2024；Zhou 等人，2025；Zhang 等人，2022）主要聚焦于特定场景、漏洞模式或检测规则，导致跨链验证漏洞缺乏系统性的语义特征描述。 与此同时，尽管大型语言模型在智能合约漏洞检测方面展现出潜力（Wei 等人，2025；Chen 等人，2025），但它们能否对这类验证语义漏洞进行推理的能力仍不明确。

paragraphs.en: To fill this gap, we conduct, to the best of our knowledge, the first systematic empirical study of cross-chain verification vulnerabilities. We collect and analyze 588 security audit reports from 36 real-world cross-chain bridge projects ( Chainspot Team, 2026 ; DeFiLlama Team, 2026 ) . We identify CVV instances from the collected audit reports based on a set of criteria. Based on these instances, we use open card sorting ( Tchivi et al., 2025 ) and incorporate cross-chain verification domain knowledge to derive CVV patterns. We identify 11 CVV patterns and organize them into 5 high-level categories according to the cross-chain verification properties they violate (e.g., message authenticity and execution integrity).
paragraphs.zh: 为了填补这一空白，据我们所知，我们开展了首个关于跨链验证漏洞的系统性实证研究。 我们收集并分析了来自 36 个真实世界跨链桥项目的 588 份安全审计报告（Chainspot Team, 2026；DeFiLlama Team, 2026）。 我们依据一套标准，从收集到的审计报告中识别出 CVV 实例。 基于这些实例，我们采用开放卡片排序法（Tchivi et al., 2025），并结合跨链验证领域的专业知识，推导出 CVV 模式。 我们识别出 11 种 CVV 模式，并根据它们所违反的跨链验证特性（例如消息真实性和执行完整性）将其归入 5 个高级类别。

sents.en: We identify 11 CVV patterns and organize them into 5 high-level categories according to the cross-chain verification properties they violate (e.g., message authenticity and execution integrity).
sents.zh: 我们识别出 11 种 CVV 模式，并根据它们所违反的跨链验证特性（例如消息真实性和执行完整性）将其归入 5 个高级类别。

paragraphs.en: Based on this taxonomy, we construct a real-world CVV dataset. For each vulnerability instance, we trace the corresponding audit report to its project repository and audited source-code version. We then identify the affected source files and map the instance to a specific CVV pattern. The resulting dataset contains 830 vulnerability instances across 786 contract files. Using this dataset, we characterize CVVs from multiple perspectives, including vulnerability distribution, severity, and cross-project diversity. These analyses reveal several key findings on how CVVs manifest within and affect real-world cross-chain bridges.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这一分类体系，我们构建了一个真实世界的 CVV 数据集。 对于每个漏洞实例，我们都会追溯其对应的审计报告，定位到所属项目仓库以及经过审计的源代码版本。 接着，我们会识别受影响的源代码文件，并将该实例映射到特定的 CVV 模式。 最终得到的数据集包含 830 个漏洞实例，分布在 786 份合约文件中。 利用这个数据集，我们从多个角度对 CVV 进行了特征分析，包括漏洞分布、严重程度以及跨项目多样性。 这些分析揭示了 CVV 在真实世界跨链桥中的表现形式及其影响的一些关键发现。

sents.zh: 基于这一分类体系，我们构建了一个真实世界的 CVV 数据集。

sents.en: For each vulnerability instance, we trace the corresponding audit report to its project repository and audited source-code version.
sents.zh: 对于每个漏洞实例，我们都会追溯其对应的审计报告，定位到所属项目仓库以及经过审计的源代码版本。

sents.en: We then identify the affected source files and map the instance to a specific CVV pattern.
sents.zh: 接着，我们会识别受影响的源代码文件，并将该实例映射到特定的 CVV 模式。

sents.en: The resulting dataset contains 830 vulnerability instances across 786 contract files.
sents.zh: 最终得到的数据集包含 830 个漏洞实例，分布在 786 份合约文件中。

sents.en: Using this dataset, we characterize CVVs from multiple perspectives, including vulnerability distribution, severity, and cross-project diversity.
sents.zh: 利用这个数据集，我们从多个角度对 CVV 进行了特征分析，包括漏洞分布、严重程度以及跨项目多样性。

sents.en: These analyses reveal several key findings on how CVVs manifest within and affect real-world cross-chain bridges.
sents.zh: 这些分析揭示了 CVV 在真实世界跨链桥中的表现形式及其影响的一些关键发现。

paragraphs.en: Finally, we evaluate the applicability of existing methods to CVV detection, including general smart contract detectors, bridge-oriented detectors, and mainstream LLMs. General-purpose tools mainly target implementation-level defects, while bridge-oriented approaches cover only selected scenarios or vulnerability patterns. LLMs are more flexible, but their performance remains inconsistent, with only two of the four evaluated models outperforming a simple constant baseline. Error analysis further attributes most failures to incomplete cross-component context and limited cross-chain semantic reasoning. These results motivate CVV-specific detection techniques that better capture cross-component context and verification semantics.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，我们评估了现有方法在 CVV 检测中的适用性，包括通用智能合约检测器、桥接导向检测器和主流 LLM。 通用工具主要针对实现层面的缺陷，而桥接导向方法仅覆盖部分特定场景或漏洞模式。 LLM 的灵活性更强，但其性能仍不一致，在评估的四款模型中，仅有两款的表现优于一个简单的常量基线模型。 错误分析进一步表明，大多数失败源于跨组件上下文信息的缺失以及跨链语义推理能力的有限性。 这些结果促使我们开发针对 CVV 的专用检测技术，以更好地捕捉跨组件上下文和验证语义。

paragraphs.en: Cross-chain bridges enable interoperability among heterogeneous blockchains through asset transfers, message passing, and state synchronization ( Notland et al., 2025 ) . Fig. 1 shows a typical workflow with a source chain, off-chain actors, and a destination chain. A user or DApp first invokes the source bridge contract, which records the operation as verifiable on-chain data. Off-chain actors collect this data and submit it to the destination chain with the message, signatures, or proof. The destination bridge contract then verifies the data and authorization before executing actions, such as minting assets, releasing funds, or invoking a target contract. Unlike single-chain contracts that rely on local state, bridge contracts must verify external-chain data before executing destination-chain operations. Although some projects, such as Optimism and Polygon, primarily serve Layer-2 scaling, we include their canonical bridge components because they enable interoperability between Ethereum and their corresponding target environments ( Yan et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 跨链桥通过资产转移、消息传递和状态同步，实现了异构区块链之间的互操作性（Notland 等，2025）。 图 1 展示了一个典型的工作流程，包括源链、链外参与者和目标链。 用户或去中心化应用（DApp）首先调用源链桥合约，该合约将操作记录为可验证的链上数据。 链外参与者收集这些数据，并将其连同消息、签名或证明一起提交到目标链。 随后，目标链桥合约在执行操作（例如铸造资产、释放资金或调用目标合约）之前，会验证数据和授权。 与依赖本地状态的单链合约不同，桥合约在执行目标链操作前必须验证外部链的数据。 尽管某些项目（如 Optimism 和 Polygon）主要服务于 Layer-2 扩展，但我们仍将其标准的桥接组件纳入其中，因为它们实现了以太坊与其对应目标环境之间的互操作性（Yan 等，2025）。

paragraphs.en: Existing cross-chain bridges use several verification mechanisms. These include multisignature schemes ( Pan et al., 2022 ) , light clients ( Chatzigiannis et al., 2022 ) , zero-knowledge proofs ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) , and optimistic verification ( Li, 2023 ) with challenge windows ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) . Each mechanism defines different evidence that the destination contract must validate. Multisignature bridges, such as Wormhole ( Wormhole Foundation, 2026b ) , rely on guardian or validator signatures and verify signature thresholds, validator membership, and message-context binding. Light-client bridges, such as Rainbow Bridge ( Aurora Labs, 2026 ) , validate source-chain consensus evidence, including block headers, state roots, Merkle proofs, message inclusion, finality, and freshness. ZK-proof bridges, such as zkBridge ( Xie et al., 2022 ) , verify the public input with a succinct proof to bind a source-chain state or message commitment to a destination-chain operation. Optimistic bridges, such as Nomad ( Nomad Labs, 2026 ) , defer acceptance until the challenge window elapses, relying on timeout enforcement, challenge handling, and dispute resolution.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的跨链桥使用多种验证机制。 这些机制包括多重签名方案（Pan 等，2022）、轻客户端（Chatzigiannis 等，2022）、零知识证明（Zhou 等，2024）以及带有挑战窗口的乐观验证（Li，2023；Zhang 等，2024）。 每种机制都定义了目标合约必须验证的不同证据。 多重签名桥，例如 Wormhole（Wormhole Foundation，2026b），依赖守护人或验证者的签名，并验证签名阈值、验证者成员资格以及消息上下文绑定。 轻客户端桥，例如 Rainbow Bridge（Aurora Labs，2026），验证源链的共识证据，包括区块头、状态根、默克尔证明、消息包含性、最终性和新鲜度。 ZK 证明桥，例如 zkBridge（Xie 等，2022），通过简洁证明验证公共输入，从而将源链的状态或消息承诺与目标链的操作绑定。 乐观桥，例如 Nomad（Nomad Labs，2026），延迟接受直到挑战窗口结束，依赖超时执行、挑战处理和争议解决。

paragraphs.en: Despite differing trust assumptions and procedures, these mechanisms share security requirements: cross-chain verification must establish data-origin authenticity and context binding, destination-chain execution integrity, freshness and non-reusability, signature or proof soundness, and trust-root correctness. This logic spans gateways, messengers, validators, relayers, proof verifiers, decoders, and execution contracts, making it more complex than single-chain execution. Consequently, missing, inconsistent, or incorrectly bound verification logic may cause the destination chain to accept invalid external-chain data and execute unauthorized cross-chain operations.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管信任假设和流程各不相同，这些机制仍共享相同的安全要求：跨链验证必须确保数据源头的真实性和上下文绑定、目标链执行的一致性、新鲜性和不可重复使用性、签名或证明的健全性，以及信任根的正确性。 这一逻辑涵盖了网关、信使、验证者、中继器、证明验证器、解码器和执行合约，因此比单链执行更为复杂。 因此，缺失、不一致或绑定错误的验证逻辑可能导致目标链接受无效的外部链数据，并执行未经授权的跨链操作。

paragraphs.en: To systematically study CVVs, we first collect real-world cross-chain bridge projects and their audit reports. Specifically, our initial data sources consist of bridge projects collected from Chainspot ( Chainspot Team, 2026 ) and DefiLlama ( DeFiLlama Team, 2026 ) , two mainstream cross-chain bridge aggregation platforms, with data retrieved as of May 2026. After deduplication and the exclusion of projects without public audit materials, we obtain 36 cross-chain bridge projects. We then search for publicly available security audit reports for each project. We collect them from project websites, GitHub repositories, and audit-firm websites. The reports involve multiple leading security teams, including Trail of Bits ( Trail of Bits, 2026 ) , OpenZeppelin ( OpenZeppelin, 2026 ) , Zellic ( Zellic, 2026 ) , Quantstamp ( Quantstamp, 2026 ) , and Code4rena ( Code4rena, 2026 ) . Because bridge projects are often audited at multiple development stages, we retain all accessible reports to maximize coverage of disclosed vulnerabilities. In total, we collect 588 security audit reports.
paragraphs.zh: 为了系统性地研究 CVVs，我们首先收集现实世界中的跨链桥项目及其审计报告。 具体而言，我们的初始数据源包括从 Chainspot（Chainspot Team，2026）和 DefiLlama（DeFiLlama Team，2026）这两个主流的跨链桥聚合平台收集到的跨链桥项目，数据截至 2026 年 5 月。 在去重并排除没有公开审计材料的项目后，我们获得了 36 个跨链桥项目。 接着，我们为每个项目搜索公开可用的安全审计报告。 我们从项目网站、GitHub 仓库和审计公司的网站上收集这些报告。 这些报告涉及多个领先的安全团队，包括 Trail of Bits（Trail of Bits，2026）、OpenZeppelin（OpenZeppelin，2026）、Zellic（Zellic，2026）、Quantstamp（Quantstamp，2026）和 Code4rena（Code4rena，2026）。 由于跨链桥项目通常会在多个开发阶段接受审计，因此我们保留了所有可获取的报告，以最大限度地覆盖已披露的漏洞。 总计，我们收集了 588 份安全审计报告。

paragraphs.en: The collected audit reports contain 6,069 security findings spanning diverse implementation defects and security issues. We manually identify CVVs through a three-stage screening procedure using the vulnerable code, descriptions, exploit scenarios, recommendations, and metadata provided in each finding (Figure 2(b) ). (i) Cross-chain Relevance: whether the finding affects a cross-chain operation, such as message transmission, asset transfer, state synchronization, verification, or destination-chain execution. (ii) Verification Relevance: whether the affected data, state, or parameters participate in cross-chain verification, including messages, proofs, signatures, state roots, validator sets, identities, and execution parameters. (iii) Verification Impact: whether the defect compromises the correctness of verification or the execution authorized by its result. A finding is labeled as a CVV only if all three criteria are satisfied.
paragraphs.zh: 收集到的审计报告包含 6,069 项安全发现，涵盖多种实现缺陷和安全问题。 我们通过一个三阶段筛选流程手动识别 CVV，该流程利用每项发现中提供的脆弱代码、描述、攻击场景、建议元数据（图 2(b)）。 (i) 跨链相关性：该发现是否影响跨链操作，例如消息传输、资产转移、状态同步、验证或目标链执行。 (ii) 验证相关性：受影响的数据、状态或参数是否参与跨链验证，包括消息、证明、签名、状态根、验证者集合、身份和执行参数。 (iii) 验证影响：该缺陷是否破坏了验证的正确性，或其结果所授权的执行过程。 仅当所有三个标准均满足时，一项发现才会被标记为 CVV。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 summarizes the screening results: among 6,069 findings, 3,942 are excluded as unrelated to cross-chain operations, 456 for lacking verification relevance, and 189 for lacking verification impact, leaving 1,482 CVVs. To reduce labeling bias, two researchers with over three years of smart contract security experience independently assign each finding to one of four screening outcomes, achieving 92.4% agreement and a Cohen’s κ \kappa of 0.85 before reconciliation ( Cohen, 1960 ) . Disagreements are resolved by jointly reviewing the audit description, affected code, and security consequences against the screening criteria; findings potentially affected by criterion refinements are re-examined. The reconciled labels form the final CVV set for taxonomy construction and dataset development.

paragraphs.en: To construct the CVV taxonomy, we apply open card sorting to the 1,482 CVVs. For each instance, we record its description, affected code, triggering condition, exploitation mechanism, security consequence, and remediation. The same two researchers independently group instances by their underlying verification failures, and iteratively merge or split candidate patterns based on verification semantics and cross-chain domain knowledge. Each pattern is characterized by its affected verification object and violated security guarantee, and mapped to one of five guarantees: message authenticity, execution integrity, replay and freshness, verification soundness, or trust management.
paragraphs.zh: 为构建 CVV 分类体系，我们对 1,482 个 CVV 应用了开放式卡片排序法。 对于每个实例，我们记录其描述、受影响的代码、触发条件、利用机制、安全后果以及修复措施。 同一两位研究人员独立地根据实例所依赖的验证失败原因对其进行分组，并基于验证语义和跨链领域知识迭代合并或拆分候选模式。 每种模式都通过其所影响的验证对象和违反的安全保障进行特征描述，并被映射到五种保障之一：消息真实性、执行完整性、重放与新鲜性、验证健全性或信任管理。

paragraphs.en: The 1,482 CVVs span 36 bridge projects and all five verification guarantees. Improper Handling of Unexpected Input (B3) is the most frequent pattern, with 705 instances (47.57%) across 31 projects. B3 captures failures in protocol-level validity checks on cross-chain data, rather than generic local input-validation defects. The remaining patterns cover identity binding, destination validation, replay protection, cryptographic verification, and trust management, showing that CVVs span multiple dimensions of cross-chain verification.
paragraphs.zh: 这 1,482 个 CVV 涵盖了 36 个桥梁项目以及全部五项验证保证。 “意外输入处理不当”（B3）是最常见的模式，在 31 个项目中共出现 705 次（占比 47.57%）。 B3 反映的是跨链数据在协议层有效性检查中的失败，而非通用的本地输入验证缺陷。 其余模式涵盖了身份绑定、目的地验证、重放保护、密码学验证和信任管理，表明 CVV 涉及跨链验证的多个维度。

paragraphs.en: We classify CVVs according to the cross-chain verification security guarantees they violate. Specifically, in Table 2 , we organize CVVs into 5 high-level categories: Message Authenticity Violation , Execution Integrity Violation , Replay and Freshness Violation , Verification Soundness Violation , and Trust Management Violation . Under these categories, we further define 11 concrete CVV patterns.
paragraphs.zh: 我们根据智能体所违反的跨链验证安全保证，对 CVV 进行分类。 具体而言，在表 2 中，我们将 CVV 分为 5 个高级类别：消息真实性违规、执行完整性违规、重放与新鲜性违规、验证健全性违规以及信任管理违规。 在这些类别下，我们进一步定义了 11 种具体的 CVV 模式。

sents.en: Specifically, in Table 2 , we organize CVVs into 5 high-level categories: Message Authenticity Violation , Execution Integrity Violation , Replay and Freshness Violation , Verification Soundness Violation , and Trust Management Violation .

paragraphs.en: (1) Message Authenticity Violation (CVV-A). Message authenticity requires the destination-chain contract to reliably identify the origin of a cross-chain message, including its source chain, source contract, sender, domain, and unique message identifier. This category contains one pattern: Missing Message Identity Binding (A1) , where a message is not fully bound to its source context. As a result, the destination-chain contract may fail to distinguish the legitimate origin of a message from a forged or mismatched context.
paragraphs.zh: (1) 消息真实性违规（CVV-A）。 消息真实性要求目标链合约能够可靠地识别跨链消息的来源，包括其源链、源合约、发送者、域和唯一消息标识符。 该类别包含一种模式：消息身份绑定缺失（A1），即消息未与其源上下文完全绑定。 因此，目标链合约可能无法将消息的合法来源与伪造或不匹配的背景区分开来。

paragraphs.en: (2) Execution Integrity Violation (CVV-B). Execution integrity requires cross-chain data to satisfy the protocol-level constraints necessary for safe execution and, once verified, to be executed consistently with the verified context, including its parameters, destination, and intended behavior. This category includes three patterns. Missing Execution Parameter Binding (B1) occurs when execution-critical parameters are not bound to the verification context. Missing Destination Validation (B2) occurs when the destination chain, target contract, or target function is not properly validated. Improper Handling of Unexpected Input (B3) occurs when malformed, unsupported, or otherwise invalid cross-chain inputs are not rejected by the required validity checks and are subsequently accepted or consumed for execution, causing destination-chain behavior to deviate from the intended cross-chain semantics.
paragraphs.zh: (2) 执行完整性违规（CVV-B）。 执行完整性要求跨链数据满足协议层面确保安全执行所必需的约束条件，并在验证通过后，与已验证的上下文（包括其参数、目标以及预期行为）保持一致地执行。 此类问题包含三种模式。 缺失执行参数绑定（B1）是指执行关键参数未与验证上下文进行绑定的情况。 缺失目标验证（B2）是指目标链、目标合约或目标函数未得到适当验证的情况。 对意外输入的异常处理（B3）是指格式错误、不支持或其他无效跨链输入未被必要的有效性检查拒绝，反而被接受或用于执行，导致目标链的行为偏离预期的跨链语义。

paragraphs.en: (3) Replay and Freshness Violation (CVV-C). Replay and freshness require cross-chain messages, proofs, signatures, and states to be unique, fresh, and single-use after verification. This category includes three patterns. Message/Proof Replay (C1) occurs when a message or proof lacks uniqueness or reuse-prevention verification. Signature Replay/Reuse (C2) occurs when a signature is not bound to a unique context, such as chain ID, contract address, nonce, or expiration. Stale State Reuse (C3) occurs when outdated states, such as stale state roots or expired validator sets, are still accepted.
paragraphs.zh: (3) 重播与新鲜性违规（CVV-C）。 重播与新鲜性要求跨链消息、证明、签名和状态在验证后具有唯一性、新鲜性和单次使用性。 该类别包含三种模式。 消息/证明重播（C1）发生在消息或证明缺乏唯一性或防重复使用验证时。 签名重播/重复使用（C2）发生在签名未绑定到唯一上下文（如链 ID、合约地址、nonce 或有效期）时。 过时状态重复使用（C3）发生在过时状态（如过时的状态根或已失效的验证者集合）仍被接受时。

sents.zh: (3) 重播与新鲜性违规（CVV-C）。

sents.en: Replay and freshness require cross-chain messages, proofs, signatures, and states to be unique, fresh, and single-use after verification.
sents.zh: 重播与新鲜性要求跨链消息、证明、签名和状态在验证后具有唯一性、新鲜性和单次使用性。

sents.en: This category includes three patterns.
sents.zh: 该类别包含三种模式。

sents.en: Message/Proof Replay (C1) occurs when a message or proof lacks uniqueness or reuse-prevention verification.
sents.zh: 消息/证明重播（C1）发生在消息或证明缺乏唯一性或防重复使用验证时。

sents.en: Signature Replay/Reuse (C2) occurs when a signature is not bound to a unique context, such as chain ID, contract address, nonce, or expiration.
sents.zh: 签名重播/重复使用（C2）发生在签名未绑定到唯一上下文（如链 ID、合约地址、nonce 或有效期）时。

sents.en: Stale State Reuse (C3) occurs when outdated states, such as stale state roots or expired validator sets, are still accepted.
sents.zh: 过时状态重复使用（C3）发生在过时状态（如过时的状态根或已失效的验证者集合）仍被接受时。

Since _getNibbleArray() derives the verification path from the first nibble without strictly validating the path prefix, different encodings may be parsed into the same path and pass verification against the same proof. However, they can still produce different request identifiers, causing the contract to treat the same proof as distinct requests and enabling proof replay.

paragraphs.en: (4) Verification Soundness Violation (CVV-D). Verification soundness requires cryptographic and logical checks in cross-chain verification to be correctly implemented. This category includes two patterns. Improper Signature Verification (D1) occurs when the logic fails to bind the message, signature, signer, and verification context. Cryptographic Implementation Error (D2) occurs when cryptographic mechanisms are incorrectly implemented, such as using wrong hash encodings, invalid proofs, or incorrect signature recovery parameters.
paragraphs.zh: (4) 验证健全性违反（CVV-D）。 验证健全性要求跨链验证中的密码学和逻辑检查必须正确实现。 该类别包含两种模式。 不当的签名验证（D1）发生在逻辑未能将消息、签名、签署人和验证上下文正确关联时。 密码学实现错误（D2）发生在密码学机制被错误实现时，例如使用了错误的哈希编码、无效的证明或不正确的签名恢复参数。

sents.en: (4) Verification Soundness Violation (CVV-D).
sents.zh: (4) 验证健全性违反（CVV-D）。

sents.en: Verification soundness requires cryptographic and logical checks in cross-chain verification to be correctly implemented.
sents.zh: 验证健全性要求跨链验证中的密码学和逻辑检查必须正确实现。

sents.en: This category includes two patterns.
sents.zh: 该类别包含两种模式。

sents.en: Improper Signature Verification (D1) occurs when the logic fails to bind the message, signature, signer, and verification context.
sents.zh: 不当的签名验证（D1）发生在逻辑未能将消息、签名、签署人和验证上下文正确关联时。

sents.en: Cryptographic Implementation Error (D2) occurs when cryptographic mechanisms are incorrectly implemented, such as using wrong hash encodings, invalid proofs, or incorrect signature recovery parameters.
sents.zh: 密码学实现错误（D2）发生在密码学机制被错误实现时，例如使用了错误的哈希编码、无效的证明或不正确的签名恢复参数。

paragraphs.en: Example: As shown in Fig. 7 , validate_signatures() accepts a message once the accumulated signer weight reaches threshold . If threshold is zero, the condition total_weight>=threshold can be satisfied trivially, allowing signatures with insufficient or even zero validator weight to pass verification. This bypasses the intended validator-weight consensus and violates the soundness of cross-chain signature verification.
paragraphs.zh: 示例：如图 7 所示，一旦累积的签名者权重达到阈值，validate_signatures() 就会接受一条消息。 如果阈值为零，则 total_weight>=threshold 这一条件可以轻易满足，从而导致验证者权重不足甚至为零的签名也能通过验证。 这会绕过原本设计的验证者权重共识机制，并破坏跨链签名验证的正确性。

paragraphs.en: (5) Trust Management Violation (CVV-E). Trust management requires the trust roots, validator sets, and related states used for verification to be valid, finalized, and current. This category includes two patterns. Improper Trust Root Management (E1) occurs when stale, non-finalized, unauthorized, or untrusted state roots are used for verification. Improper Validator Set Management (E2) allows invalid, expired, or insufficiently weighted validators to participate in verification.
paragraphs.zh: (5) 信任管理违规（CVV-E）。 信任管理要求用于验证的信任根、验证器集及相关状态必须有效、已最终确定且为最新状态。 该类别包含两种模式。 不当的信任根管理（E1）是指使用过时、未最终确定、未经授权或不可信的状态根进行验证。 不当的验证器集管理（E2）允许无效、已过期或权重不足的验证器参与验证。

sents.en: (5) Trust Management Violation (CVV-E).
sents.zh: (5) 信任管理违规（CVV-E）。

sents.en: Trust management requires the trust roots, validator sets, and related states used for verification to be valid, finalized, and current.
sents.zh: 信任管理要求用于验证的信任根、验证器集及相关状态必须有效、已最终确定且为最新状态。

sents.en: This category includes two patterns.
sents.zh: 该类别包含两种模式。

sents.en: Improper Trust Root Management (E1) occurs when stale, non-finalized, unauthorized, or untrusted state roots are used for verification.
sents.zh: 不当的信任根管理（E1）是指使用过时、未最终确定、未经授权或不可信的状态根进行验证。

sents.en: Improper Validator Set Management (E2) allows invalid, expired, or insufficiently weighted validators to participate in verification.
sents.zh: 不当的验证器集管理（E2）允许无效、已过期或权重不足的验证器参与验证。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 summarizes our CVV dataset. Of the 1,482 CVVs identified in Section 3 , 830 instances with reliably recovered audited versions are retained, covering 209 audit reports and 27 bridge projects. Each dataset entry corresponds to one report and includes all retained CVVs, which are mapped to 786 source-code files. paragraphs.en: Table 4 summarizes the distribution of 830 CVVs across 5 categories and 11 patterns. The distribution is highly imbalanced: Execution Integrity accounts for 577 instances (69.52%), followed by Trust Management with 87 (10.48%), while Verification Soundness is the least frequent with 21 (2.53%). At the pattern level, Improper Handling of Unexpected Input (B3) is the most prevalent, with 409 instances (49.28%), followed by Missing Execution Parameter Binding (B1) with 100 (12.05%). This concentration shows that many real-world CVVs arise in how authenticated cross-chain data is interpreted, constrained, and consumed during destination-chain execution, rather than in cryptographic verification alone.

paragraphs.en: In this section, we evaluate the detectability of CVVs and answer the following research questions:

paragraphs.en: RQ1. How applicable are existing smart contract vulnerability detectors to CVV detection? We assess their inputs, cross-contract analysis capabilities, and coverage of CVV patterns.
paragraphs.zh: RQ1. 现有的智能合约漏洞检测工具在 CVV 检测方面的适用性如何？ 我们评估了它们的输入、跨合约分析能力以及对 CVV 模式的覆盖范围。

sents.zh: 我们评估了它们的输入、跨合约分析能力以及对 CVV 模式的覆盖范围。

paragraphs.en: To answer RQ1, we assess the documented applicability of 12 representative tools to CVV detection, including 8 traditional single-chain tools mainly from SmartBugs ( Durieux et al., 2020 ) and 4 cross-chain-related tools. We evaluate them along three dimensions: supported input, analysis scope, and CVV pattern coverage.

paragraphs.en: Tool input. Most tools analyze Solidity source files or EVM bytecode, whereas real-world bridge systems may additionally involve non-EVM components written in Rust or Go, as well as proof generators and validator services. Bytecode-based tools also lose part of the source-level semantics needed to interpret verification-specific logic. These heterogeneous input requirements limit the applicability of existing tools to CVV analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 工具输入。 大多数工具会分析 Solidity 源文件或 EVM 字节码，而现实中的桥接系统可能还涉及用 Rust 或 Go 编写的非 EVM 组件，以及证明生成器和验证器服务。 基于字节码的工具还会丢失部分源代码层面的语义，而这些语义对于解释验证相关的特定逻辑是必需的。 这些异构的输入要求限制了现有工具在 CVV 分析中的适用性。

Among cross-chain-related tools, SmartAxe and XGuard support cross-contract or cross-chain semantic analysis, whereas BridgeGuard and ChainSniper focus on more specific interaction or classification scenarios.

paragraphs.en: To evaluate LLM-based CVV detection, we select four mainstream models: GPT-5.5, Opus-4.8, Composer-2.5, and DeepSeek-V4-Pro. The selection considers availability, code understanding, reasoning capability, and model-family diversity. We also conduct small-scale pilot experiments on GPT-5.4 and Qwen3.7-Max. Because they underperform on sampled CVV cases, we exclude them from the formal evaluation for efficiency and comparability.

paragraphs.en: Prompt design. Following prior work on LLM-based smart contract vulnerability detection ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , we use a taxonomy-guided multi-label prompt that provides an auditor role, definitions of all 11 CVV patterns, the source-code input, analysis requirements, and a unified JSON schema. In one response, the model determines whether any CVV is present and, for each predicted pattern, reports the vulnerable function, code evidence, reasoning, and a brief exploit path; it also identifies any missing context. We apply the same prompt template across all models. Outputs that cannot be parsed or do not contain a valid decision are treated as negative predictions.
paragraphs.zh: 提示词设计。 基于先前关于 LLM 智能合约漏洞检测的研究（Chen 等人，2025），我们采用一种由分类体系指导的多标签提示词，其中定义了审计员角色、全部 11 种 CVV 模式的定义、源代码输入、分析要求以及统一的 JSON 模式。 在单次响应中，模型会判断是否存在任何 CVV，并对每种预测的模式报告存在漏洞的函数、代码证据、推理过程以及简要的攻击路径；同时也会识别任何缺失的上下文信息。 我们在所有模型中均使用相同的提示词模板。 无法解析或不含有效决策结果的输出将被视为负面预测。

paragraphs.en: Constant baseline. Because each audit report may contain multiple CVV patterns and their report-level frequencies are imbalanced, we include an all-pattern constant baseline that predicts all 11 CVV patterns for every report. For a pattern with report-level prevalence p p , this baseline has precision p p , recall 1 1 , and an F1 score of 2 ​ p / ( 1 + p ) 2p/(1+p) . We compute the baseline F1 for each pattern and macro-average the resulting scores across all 11 patterns. This baseline provides a prevalence-aware reference for determining whether a model offers discriminative value beyond predicting every pattern as present.
paragraphs.zh: 恒定基线。 由于每份审计报告可能包含多种 CVV 模式，且这些模式在报告层面的频率分布不均衡，因此我们引入了一种全模式恒定基线，该基线对每份报告都预测全部 11 种 CVV 模式。 对于报告层面流行率为 p 的模式，该基线的精确度为 p，召回率为 1，F1 得分为 2p/(1+p)。 我们计算每种模式的基线 F1 值，并对所有 11 种模式的结果进行宏平均。 该基线提供了一个考虑流行率的参考标准，用于判断模型是否具备超越“预测所有模式均存在”的判别能力。

paragraphs.en: To answer RQ3, we manually analyze the false negatives and false positives produced by the four LLMs, and summarize the main causes of missed and incorrect CVV reports.
paragraphs.zh: 为回答研究问题3，我们手动分析了四款大型语言模型产生的假阴性和假阳性结果，并总结了CVV报告出现遗漏和错误的主要原因。

paragraphs.en: False negatives. We identify two main causes of missed CVVs. (1) Missing cross-component context. CVVs often span gateways, messengers, validators, relayers, and application contracts. When input contains only a local contract or partial files, key verification logic may be missing, causing models to report no CVV. For example, in Axelar’s deposit service audit, the unauthorized token-sending vulnerability depends on interactions among deposit addresses, DepositReceiver , and the gateway. Given only source-side helper contracts, models classify it as safe, despite noting the missing gateway logic in missing_context . (2) Insufficient fine-grained semantics. Patterns such as C2, D1, D2, and E2 are often missed because they depend on protocol-specific rules rather than explicit missing checks. For instance, in Axelar’s NCC audit, models detect session-level signature reuse (C2) but miss the ground-truth D1 instance, where weighted-multisig validity depends on signature ordering.
paragraphs.zh: 假阴性。 我们识别出漏检 CVV 的两个主要原因。 （1）缺少跨组件上下文。 CVV 通常涉及网关、消息传递器、验证器、中继器和应用合约。 当输入仅包含本地合约或部分文件时，关键的验证逻辑可能缺失，导致模型报告无 CVV。 例如，在 Axelar 的存款服务审计中，未经授权的代币发送漏洞取决于存款地址、DepositReceiver 和网关之间的交互。 如果仅提供源侧的辅助合约，模型会将其分类为安全，尽管 missing_context 中已指出缺少网关逻辑。 （2）细粒度语义不足。 C2、D1、D2 和 E2 等模式常常被漏检，因为它们依赖协议特定的规则，而非明确的缺失检查。 例如，在 Axelar 的 NCC 审计中，模型检测到了会话级别的签名重复使用（C2），但漏检了真实情况中的 D1 实例——该实例中加权多重签名的有效性取决于签名的顺序。

paragraphs.en: False positives. We identify two main causes of incorrect CVV reports. (1) Surface-level pattern matching. Models often associate keywords or local code fragments, such as trust root , validator set , stale state , and execute , with CVV patterns without verifying whether the corresponding mechanism is actually missing or misused. For example, Cannon’s fault-proof VM is misclassified as C3 because its Merkle witnesses and state roots resemble stale-state reuse, although they serve a different verification purpose. (2) Misjudged trust boundaries. Models may also ignore that signature verification, replay protection, and validator checks are often delegated to gateways or messaging frameworks. For example, in an Axelar application contract, the execution function does not directly check the source-chain parameter. However, this is safe because the upstream gateway has already authenticated the cross-chain message. Models miss this trust boundary and incorrectly report it as an A1 CVV.
paragraphs.zh: 误报。 我们识别出导致 CVV 报告错误的主要原因有两个。 (1) 表层模式匹配。 模型常常将关键词或局部代码片段（例如 trust root、validator set、stale state 和 execute）与 CVV 模式关联起来，却没有验证相应的机制是否确实缺失或被滥用。 例如，Cannon 的防故障虚拟机被错误地归类为 C3，因为它的默克尔见证和状态根类似于旧状态的重用，尽管它们服务于不同的验证目的。 (2) 误判的信任边界。 模型还可能忽略这样一个事实：签名验证、重放保护和验证者检查通常被委托给网关或消息框架。 例如，在 Axelar 的应用合约中，执行函数并未直接检查源链参数。 然而，这是安全的，因为上游网关已经对跨链消息进行了身份验证。 模型忽略了这一信任边界，并错误地将其报告为 A1 CVV。

paragraphs.en: Taken together, the false-negative and false-positive cases reveal a common limitation of LLM-based CVV detection: models struggle to reconstruct complete verification flows and reason about protocol-level semantics. As a result, they may miss vulnerabilities with cross-component evidence, falsely report checks delegated to upstream frameworks, or rely on keywords for semantics-heavy patterns involving replay protection, cryptographic verification, validator sets, and trust-root management.
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，假阴性和假阳性案例揭示了基于大型语言模型（LLM）的 CVV 检测的一个共同局限性：这些模型难以重建完整的验证流程，并无法对协议层面的语义进行推理。 因此，它们可能会遗漏涉及跨组件证据的安全漏洞，错误地报告已委托给上游框架的检查项，或者在涉及重放保护、加密验证、验证器集和信任根管理的复杂语义模式中依赖关键词进行判断。

paragraphs.en: CVVs are not merely audit findings, but have been repeatedly exploited in real-world bridge attacks. To assess their impact, we analyze 74 public cross-chain bridge incidents reported since 2021 ( SlowMist Security Team, 2026 ) . After excluding incidents unrelated to cross-chain verification, including phishing, DNS/BGP hijacking, and unknown causes, we identify 34 involving bridge verification or execution logic; 21 (61.8%) are CVV-related. Table 10 shows that the 11 most recent CVV-related incidents in 2026 caused approximately $329.3 million in losses. They include forged messages, invalid proofs, missing source-channel checks, gateway verification bypasses, ambiguous encoding, and trust-root or prover-management flaws. This diversity shows that CVVs span bridge implementations and verification mechanisms but share a common behavior: the destination chain accepts invalid external-chain data. This can enable unauthorized withdrawals, unbacked asset minting, or compromised privileged operations. These observations motivate treating CVVs as a distinct vulnerability class and developing dedicated taxonomies, datasets, and detection techniques.

sents.en: This diversity shows that CVVs span bridge implementations and verification mechanisms but share a common behavior: the destination chain accepts invalid external-chain data.
sents.zh: 这种多样性表明，CVV 涉及跨链桥的不同实现和验证机制，但它们有一个共同的行为：目标链接受了来自外部链的无效数据。

sents.en: This can enable unauthorized withdrawals, unbacked asset minting, or compromised privileged operations.
sents.zh: 这可能导致未经授权的提款、无背书的资产铸造，或特权操作被劫持。

sents.en: These observations motivate treating CVVs as a distinct vulnerability class and developing dedicated taxonomies, datasets, and detection techniques.
sents.zh: 这些观察结果促使我们将 CVV 视为一个独立的漏洞类别，并开发专门的分类体系、数据集和检测技术。

paragraphs.en: To examine security implications beyond individual patterns, we analyze CVVs across four lifecycle stages: design, implementation, deployment, and maintenance. We assign each CVV to its most likely origin and exclude instances whose root causes cannot be reliably determined from audit reports and code evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 为了考察超越单个模式的安全影响，我们分析了 CVV 在四个生命周期阶段中的情况：设计、实施、部署和维护。 我们将每个 CVV 归因于其最可能的来源，并排除那些无法通过审计报告和代码证据可靠确定根本原因的情况。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Fig. 11 , CVVs arise throughout the lifecycle. Implementation accounts for the largest share, with 493 cases (59.76%), mostly in CVV-B, highlighting execution constraints as a common cross-chain verification challenge. However, frequency does not imply severity. Design-stage CVVs are fewer, with 135 cases (16.36%), but have the highest High-severity ratio, suggesting that flaws in core verification assumptions, including message identity binding, replay protection, destination routing, and trust-root management, tend to be more severe. Deployment and maintenance contribute 120 (14.55%) and 77 (9.33%) cases, respectively, showing that CVVs also arise after implementation through misconfiguration, stale states, validator-set rotation errors, or unsafe trust-root updates. These results justify the lifecycle perspective: CVV mitigation should address not only implementation-stage vulnerabilities, but also verification assumptions in the design stage, deployment validation, and trust-state changes during maintenance.

paragraphs.en: To examine whether CVVs are temporary vulnerabilities or persistent risks, we analyze their temporal distribution by audit-report year. As shown in Fig. 12 , CVV instances generally increase from 2020 to 2025, rising from 28 to 202 instances and reaching their highest level in 2025. Since 2026 is still ongoing, we treat it as a partial-year observation rather than evidence of decline. This temporal view covers 824 instances after excluding six instances with unreliable dates. The most notable trend is the persistent dominance of CVV-B, the execution-integrity category, across all years. This indicates that execution-related CVVs are not merely early-stage vulnerabilities in immature bridges. Instead, even as bridge systems evolve, contracts repeatedly fail to properly constrain cross-chain message inputs, execution parameters, destination routing, and post-verification behaviors. Therefore, execution integrity remains a long-term structural challenge in cross-chain verification security.
paragraphs.zh: 为了探究 CVV 是临时性漏洞还是持续性风险，我们按审计报告年份分析了其时间分布。 如图 12 所示，CVV 实例从 2020 年到 2025 年总体呈上升趋势，由 28 例增至 202 例，并在 2025 年达到最高水平。 由于 2026 年仍在进行中，我们将其视为部分年份的观察结果，而非下降的证据。 在排除六个日期不可靠的实例后，这一时间维度的分析共涵盖 824 个实例。 最显著的趋势是，CVV-B（执行完整性类别）在所有年份中均持续占据主导地位。 这表明，与执行相关的 CVV 并非仅仅是未成熟桥接系统中的早期漏洞。 相反，即使桥接系统不断演进，合约仍反复未能正确约束跨链消息输入、执行参数、目标路由以及验证后的行为。 因此，执行完整性仍然是跨链验证安全领域一项长期的结构性挑战。

paragraphs.en: Our findings suggest four priorities for CVV research and practice. (1) Model execution semantics beyond authentication. Since 69.52% of CVVs violate execution integrity, analyses should track how authenticated cross-chain data is bound to identities, destinations, parameters, and execution state. (2) Reason across bridge components. Because CVVs often span gateways, messengers, validators, and application contracts, detectors should model delegated checks and trust boundaries across components. (3) Prioritize by prevalence and severity. Less frequent patterns such as E1 and C1 still exhibit relatively high proportions of High-severity cases; triage should therefore consider both frequency and impact. (4) Develop CVV-specific detectors. Existing tools provide limited documented coverage, while LLMs struggle with incomplete context and protocol-specific semantics. Future detectors should combine cross-component analysis with explicit models of verification guarantees.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究结果指出了 CVV 研究和实践的四项优先事项。 (1) 超越身份验证的模型执行语义。 由于 69.52% 的 CVV 违反了执行完整性，分析应追踪经过身份验证的跨链数据如何与身份、目的地、参数和执行状态绑定。 (2) 跨桥接组件进行推理。 由于 CVV 通常涉及网关、消息传递器、验证器和应用合约，检测器应对跨组件的委托检查和信任边界进行建模。 (3) 根据普遍性和严重性确定优先级。 E1 和 C1 这类出现频率较低的模式仍然表现出相对较高的“高严重性”案例比例；因此，分类处理应同时考虑频率和影响。 (4) 开发针对 CVV 的专用检测器。 现有工具提供的文档覆盖范围有限，而大型语言模型则难以处理不完整的上下文和特定协议的语义。 未来的检测器应将跨组件分析与验证保证的显式模型相结合。

paragraphs.en: Internal validity. Potential biases may arise in CVV identification, taxonomy construction, code mapping, and detection evaluation. Audit reports vary in terminology, granularity, and disclosure style, which may affect manual labeling. To mitigate this threat, we define CVV inclusion criteria, classify findings by violated cross-chain verification properties, and iteratively refine the taxonomy. Code mapping may be affected by private repositories, deleted commits, pull requests, or version-diff-based targets. We cross-check repository metadata, commits, files, and functions, excluding cases with insufficient evidence from metadata-sensitive analyses. For LLM evaluation, we use the same prompt template, input format, output schema, dataset, and metrics across models. Nevertheless, outputs may vary across runs, model versions, and service configurations; our results therefore characterize the evaluated versions and settings rather than immutable model capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 内部效度。 在 CVV 识别、分类体系构建、代码映射和检测评估中，可能会出现潜在的偏见。 审计报告在术语、详细程度和披露风格上存在差异，这可能会影响人工标注。 为缓解这一威胁，我们定义了 CVV 的纳入标准，按违反的跨链验证属性对发现进行分类，并迭代完善分类体系。 代码映射可能受到私有仓库、已删除提交、拉取请求或基于版本差异的目标的影响。 我们交叉验证了仓库元数据、提交、文件和函数，并将缺乏足够证据的情况排除在元数据敏感分析之外。 对于 LLM 评估，我们在所有模型中均使用相同的提示模板、输入格式、输出模式、数据集和指标。 尽管如此，不同运行、模型版本和服务配置可能会导致输出存在差异；因此，我们的结果反映的是所评估的版本和设置，而非不可更改的模型能力。

Nevertheless, our dataset covers diverse bridge projects, languages, verification mechanisms, and CVV patterns, and we release the dataset and detection results to support future research.

paragraphs.en: Prior work has extensively studied single-chain smart contract vulnerabilities. Existing approaches use static analysis ( Feist et al., 2019 ) , symbolic execution ( Luu et al., 2016 ) , fuzzing ( Torres et al., 2021 ) , formal verification ( Hildenbrandt et al., 2018 ) , and rule-based detection ( Tikhomirov et al., 2018 ) . They target common vulnerability patterns, including reentrancy, integer overflows, timestamp dependence, unchecked calls and unsafe delegatecall. Recent work also studies specific vulnerability classes, using empirical datasets and dedicated analyses. Representative examples include access-control vulnerabilities ( Ghaleb et al., 2023 ) , centralization defects ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , cryptographic defects ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) , proxy-contract issues ( Zhang et al., 2025c ) , and code-cloning vulnerabilities ( Mo et al., 2025 ) . However, these studies are grounded in single-chain execution semantics, which rely on local state, intra-chain flows, or single-chain transactions, making them insufficient for characterizing vulnerabilities rooted in cross-chain verification semantics.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的研究广泛探讨了单链智能合约中的漏洞。 现有方法采用了静态分析（Feist 等人，2019）、符号执行（Luu 等人，2016）、模糊测试（Torres 等人，2021）、形式化验证（Hildenbrandt 等人，2018）以及基于规则的检测（Tikhomirov 等人，2018）。 这些方法针对常见的漏洞模式，包括重入、整数溢出、时间戳依赖、未检查的调用和不安全的委托调用。 近期的研究还利用经验数据集和专门的分析方法，探讨了特定的漏洞类别。 代表性例子包括访问控制漏洞（Ghaleb 等人，2023）、中心化缺陷（Lin 等人，2025）、密码学缺陷（Zhang 等人，2025a）、代理合约问题（Zhang 等人，2025c）以及代码克隆漏洞（Mo 等人，2025）。 然而，这些研究都基于单链执行语义，即依赖局部状态、链内流程或单链交易，因此不足以描述源于跨链验证语义的漏洞。

sents.zh: 这些方法针对常见的漏洞模式，包括重入、整数溢出、时间戳依赖、未检查的调用和不安全的委托调用。

sents.en: Recent work also studies specific vulnerability classes, using empirical datasets and dedicated analyses.
sents.zh: 近期的研究还利用经验数据集和专门的分析方法，探讨了特定的漏洞类别。

sents.en: Representative examples include access-control vulnerabilities ( Ghaleb et al., 2023 ) , centralization defects ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , cryptographic defects ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) , proxy-contract issues ( Zhang et al., 2025c ) , and code-cloning vulnerabilities ( Mo et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 代表性例子包括访问控制漏洞（Ghaleb 等人，2023）、中心化缺陷（Lin 等人，2025）、密码学缺陷（Zhang 等人，2025a）、代理合约问题（Zhang 等人，2025c）以及代码克隆漏洞（Mo 等人，2025）。

sents.en: However, these studies are grounded in single-chain execution semantics, which rely on local state, intra-chain flows, or single-chain transactions, making them insufficient for characterizing vulnerabilities rooted in cross-chain verification semantics.
sents.zh: 然而，这些研究都基于单链执行语义，即依赖局部状态、链内流程或单链交易，因此不足以描述源于跨链验证语义的漏洞。

paragraphs.en: Recent studies have investigated bridge-specific security vulnerabilities. Xscope presents an early study of cross-chain bridge attacks and detects attack behaviors from historical transactions ( Zhang et al., 2022 ) . Later studies shift from transaction-based forensics to pre-exploitation contract-level analysis. SmartAxe targets access-control incompleteness and cross-bridge semantic inconsistency in bridge contracts ( Liao et al., 2024 ) , while XGuard detects inconsistent behaviors between source- and destination-chain contracts ( Wang et al., 2024 ) . BridgeGuard studies external interaction vulnerabilities in bridge router contracts ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) . ChainSniper examines common vulnerabilities in cross-chain contracts ( Tran et al., 2024 ) . However, these works remain limited to specific scenarios, such as post-hoc forensics, bridge DApp workflows, or router-contract interactions, and do not systematically examine vulnerabilities across the cross-chain verification process.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we conduct the first systematic empirical study of cross-chain verification vulnerabilities (CVVs). By analyzing 588 audit reports from 36 real-world bridges, we derive a taxonomy of 11 CVV patterns in 5 categories and construct a dataset of 830 CVV instances. Our study characterizes their distribution, severity, and cross-project diversity, and evaluates the applicability of existing detectors and LLMs. The results show that current approaches provide limited and inconsistent CVV detection, largely due to insufficient cross-component context and cross-chain semantic reasoning. These findings highlight the need for CVV-specific analysis that models end-to-end verification semantics and for evaluation methods that account for pattern prevalence. Future work will explore such techniques to improve the security and reliability of cross-chain bridges.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们首次对跨链验证漏洞（CVVs）进行了系统性的实证研究。 通过分析来自36个真实世界桥接协议的588份审计报告，我们归纳出5类共11种CVV模式，并构建了一个包含830个CVV实例的数据集。 我们的研究描述了这些漏洞的分布、严重程度和跨项目多样性，并评估了现有检测工具和大型语言模型（LLMs）的应用效果。 研究结果表明，当前方法在CVV检测方面的效果有限且不一致，这主要归因于缺乏足够的跨组件上下文信息和跨链语义推理能力。 这些发现凸显了对特定CVV分析的需求——这种分析需要能够建模端到端验证语义，同时还需要考虑模式普遍性的评估方法。 未来的工作将探索此类技术，以提升跨链桥接协议的安全性和可靠性。
